text:
Rhea: Postmortem posted — recurring evening tail latency. Need SLO follow-ups and owners.
Omar: quick numbers?
Rhea: p95 ~190ms, p99 ~430ms, spikes to ~1.5s during Tue/Thu 17:00-19:00.
Leah: propose adding a burst SLI (p999 / 5m) + dashboards; keep customer-facing SLA stable.
Marcus: agree. also propose routing heavy requests to quantized fallback when queue_ms > 300 AND inflight_per_gpu > 30.
Omar: also add a short throttle at p95 queue threshold to avoid global fallback.
Marcus: config sketch:
```yaml
serving:
  fallback: quantized-v2
  guards:
    queue_ms_threshold: 300
    max_inflight_per_gpu: 30
  throttles:
    p95_queue_ms: 120
```
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget_burn rate=0.41 over 24h; recent spikes Tue 17:15-18:05. Link: https://console.redwood/slo/zz
Tina: I'll own dashboards — panels: p95, p99, p999-burst(5m), burn-rate by weekday/hour, queue-depth heatmap, incident annotations.
Rhea: Action items & owners/dates: 1) Burst SLI + dashboards — Tina — due 2026-04-29. 2) Routing guard + throttles — Marcus — due 2026-04-24. 3) Canary plan (48h synthetic peak) — Leah — due 2026-05-09. 4) Follow-up postmortem doc with acceptance/rollback criteria — Omar — due 2026-04-30.
Leah: canary will collect kv-cache hit rates, per-model queue metrics, and token-level latencies; will post exact steps to the follow-up doc.
Omar: draft rollback criteria: rollback if error-budget burn increases >10% post-change OR p95 degrades >20% vs baseline.
Rhea: do NOT change customer SLA for now. deploy guards + dashboards, monitor for 14 days, then revisit SLO roll.
Marcus: opening serving-config PR today, tagging @ops for review and tests.
Tina: dashboard PR by EOD Wednesday, will annotate incidents and add explainer for burst SLI.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window 2026-04-25 02:00-03:00 UTC (informational).
Rhea: creating action tracker card and will ping owners daily until closed. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
